def components(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]; comps=[]

        for c in range(W):
            if g[r][c] and not seen[r][c]:
                col=g[r][c]; q=deque([(r,c)]); seen[r][c]=True; cells=[]
                while q:
                    y,x=q.popleft(); cells.append((y,x))
                    for dy,dx in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):

def norm(cells):
    rs=[r for r,_ in cells]; cs=[c for _,c in cells]
    r0,c0=min(rs),min(cs)
    h=max(rs)-r0+1; w=max(cs)-c0+1
    m=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for r,c in cells: m[r-r0][c-c0]=1
    return m
